'''Takhal nuts''' were a type of [[Nut/Legends|nut]] that was edible by [[Human/Legends|Humans]] and sometimes served roasted.<ref name="Patterns" /> Around [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Coruscant Nights III: Patterns of Force]]'' to around [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]].</ref> the [[Zeltron/Legends|Zeltron]] [[Dejah Duare]] purchased roasted takhal nuts and [[sweet ice]] for the Human [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Kajin Savaros]] at a small [[Unidentified Coruscant bazaar|bazaar]] on the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Patterns" />

==Behind the scenes==
Takhal nuts first appeared in ''[[Coruscant Nights III: Patterns of Force]]'', a [[2009]] novel that was written by [[Michael Reaves]]<ref name="Patterns" /> with help from [[Maya Kaathryn Bohnhoff]].<ref name="Bohnhoff">{{WebCite|url=http://paperdragonink.com/?p=1817|text=Interview with Author Maya Kaathryn Bohnhoff >> Paper Dragon ink|author=Lentes, Douglas|date=2012-01-15, 9:39 pm|work=Paper Dragon ink|archivedate=20120120015419}}</ref>
